purpose: Replace the main results with one common three-model evaluation; no retraining or checkpoint selection.
policy: deterministic actor mean; flat, rough, recovery in this fixed order
initial_states: Reseed and reset before each policy; require equal root/joint initial-state SHA-256 within each seed.
terrain: One shared generated terrain instance per seed; identical environment settings for all policies.
observation: Common 60D ground-relative-height adapter, including the flat-trained policy.
selection_rule: Use all five declared seeds and all first episodes. No seed, checkpoint or hyperparameter selection after evaluation.
historical_results: results/transfer and results/rewards remain archived; excluded from this aggregate.
